profile.purpose: An experimental, physics-inspired hardware research profile for expressing quantum-device models, field simulations, reproducible experiments, material models, fabrication plans and consent-based BCI input through typed, inspectable operations.
non_goals: No claim of control below the physical laws of a device.
No direct manipulation of quantum vacuum, probability, spacetime, causality or past events.
No generation of matter from thought or from electrical energy without a physically specified process and feedstock.
No implicit access to privileged CPU registers, MMIO, DMA, firmware, sensors or neural interfaces.

ownership.reaper: Owns the canonical parser, syntax/grammar, typing, effects, diagnostics, Span/SourceMap and typed IR. Omega-Null must lower through canonical Reaper contracts, not fork the compiler.
ownership.pytyliki: Owns the research profile, hardware/physics model descriptors, simulation orchestration, evidence and target adapter registry.
ownership.duck_os: Mediates process isolation, device permissions, sensor/BCI access, driver lifecycle and privileged hardware services.
ownership.board_and_lab_backends: Provide exact board, quantum-device, materials, fabrication and laboratory tool adapters; each adapter declares identity, revision, calibration and safety limits.

semantic_layers.name: Marker surface
semantic_layers.scope: The user-facing resonant markers, aliases and block delimiters.
semantic_layers.execution: Normalize only; symbols do not independently cause physical effects.

semantic_layers.name: Typed research operations
semantic_layers.scope: Quantum, field, experiment, time-model, material and BCI domain calls.
semantic_layers.execution: Type/effect checked by Reaper; target and evidence mode required.

semantic_layers.name: Model and simulator
semantic_layers.scope: Deterministic or seeded probabilistic simulation of declared models.
semantic_layers.execution: Runs against named models with explicit bounds and model provenance.

semantic_layers.name: Artifact and tool adapters
semantic_layers.scope: Circuit descriptions, RTL, netlists, CAD, manufacturing plans and external EDA tools.
semantic_layers.execution: Produces files/plans; execution is opt-in and toolchain-versioned.

semantic_layers.name: Physical target
semantic_layers.scope: Named quantum devices, sensors, fabrication equipment or embedded boards.
semantic_layers.execution: Requires trusted device adapter, capabilities, calibration, operator consent and separate hardware qualification.

marker_semantics.semantics: Create a typed session context with target, execution mode, effect budget and provenance.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Big Bang or creation of a physical universe.

marker_semantics.semantics: Open a root scope with versioned state and explicit initial conditions.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: A singularity or break in causality.

marker_semantics.semantics: Select an explicit CPU, simulator, device, board, model or lab target.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: A global physical field or unrestricted system access.

marker_semantics.semantics: Set timeout, cancellation, safe-stop and cleanup policies.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: An irreversible event horizon or point of no return.

marker_semantics.semantics: Choose transistor, gate, circuit, ISA, microarchitecture, device or system abstraction level.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: A quantum energy transition in hardware.

marker_semantics.intent: Filter candidate states or experiment branches.
marker_semantics.semantics: Apply a typed predicate, constraint or probability threshold to model results.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Forcing nature to select a desired quantum outcome.

marker_semantics.semantics: Execute or simulate a declared operation only after target/effect/capability admission.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: A vector of force applied directly to matter.

marker_semantics.intent: Declare a large bounded data/model region.
marker_semantics.semantics: Create a typed storage, tensor, state-vector or dataset region with capacity limits.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Storing arbitrary information in spacetime curvature.

marker_semantics.intent: Query available resources or model state.
marker_semantics.semantics: Perform a read-only query against a declared provider or simulator.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Querying a quantum vacuum for arbitrary resources.

marker_semantics.intent: Expand a model or engineering workflow.
marker_semantics.semantics: Create bounded child tasks, generated source or simulation jobs with lineage.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Organic creation of physical matter.

marker_semantics.intent: Materialize an abstract design as a concrete engineering artifact.
marker_semantics.semantics: Emit a source file, IR, netlist, RTL, CAD model, build plan or manufacturing job file.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Converting thought directly into atoms or a physical object.

marker_semantics.intent: Bring in a declared utility module.
marker_semantics.semantics: Resolve a versioned local module or pinned adapter dependency.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: An unrestricted foundation that bypasses capabilities.

marker_semantics.semantics: Synchronize logical clocks, signal phases or datasets under a declared clock model.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Instantaneous synchronization across spacetime or faster-than-light signaling.

marker_semantics.intent: Prepare candidate branches and search paths.
marker_semantics.semantics: Build a bounded branch-and-bound, search or parameter-sweep plan.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Prediction or traversal of actual alternate timelines.

marker_semantics.semantics: Run bounded jobs on actual compute resources or named simulators and compare reproducible outputs.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Creating or collapsing parallel physical universes.

marker_semantics.intent: Apply domain laws and model constraints.
marker_semantics.semantics: Enforce dimensioned equations, conservation laws, boundary conditions, unitarity or causality where applicable.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: A command that changes universal physical constants.

marker_semantics.semantics: Perform a validated state-machine transition or dispatch to an explicitly defined execution stage.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Quantum tunneling or skipping physical time.

marker_semantics.semantics: Create or inspect an entangled state in a declared simulator/device model and validate no-signaling constraints.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Communication without a physical channel or faster-than-light signaling.

marker_semantics.semantics: Attach version, source digest, model/device identity and reproducibility metadata.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Manipulating the timeline or history of the universe.

marker_semantics.semantics: Run declared checks and emit a typed verification report with scope and evidence level.
marker_semantics.forbidden_interpretation: Proof that an unobservable metaphysical event occurred.

operation_catalog.semantics: Prepare a quantum state using a declared circuit/state-preparation sequence; report model and device constraints.
constraints: No arbitrary selection of a desired measurement result.
Hardware execution requires a named device, calibration and explicit capability.

operation_catalog.semantics: Apply a supported unitary gate or calibrated device operation to the selected qubit/register set.
constraints: Gate set, connectivity, noise and compilation constraints are target-specific.

operation_catalog.semantics: Measure in a declared basis and return an observation/sample distribution with seed or device provenance.
constraints: Outcome is governed by the declared model or device behavior.
The operation cannot force a chosen outcome or recover arbitrary classical secrets from superposition.

operation_catalog.semantics: Solve a declared field/evolution equation on a bounded domain with units, discretization, boundary conditions and solver tolerances.
constraints: Does not alter physical spacetime or slow real-world time.

operation_catalog.semantics: Run resource-bounded candidate evaluation with pinned inputs, seeds, budgets and an explicit objective function.
constraints: Only actual compute resources and explicitly named simulations are used.
Candidate score and confidence are reported; no future or alternate reality is accessed.

operation_catalog.semantics: Create a restricted process, VM, simulator or model sandbox with memory, CPU, I/O and time budgets.
constraints: Isolation strength must name the actual platform mechanism.
A simulator sandbox is not a physically separate universe.

operation_catalog.semantics: Capture a versioned logical state with event index, input digest and model identity.
constraints: Checkpoint is not a backup of the physical world.

operation_catalog.semantics: Replay a recorded model execution or event log and report the first divergence.
constraints: Replay does not reverse external physical events or restore an earlier real time.

operation_catalog.semantics: Construct a typed atomic, molecular, crystal or material structure from validated species, bonds, geometry and model assumptions.
constraints: The result is a model/design artifact unless separately fabricated and measured.

operation_catalog.semantics: Generate or validate CAD/EDA/3D-printing/manufacturing job data against material, machine, feedstock and process constraints.
constraints: Physical fabrication requires suitable equipment, feedstock, safety controls and operator approval.
No claim of creating matter from vacuum or thought.

operation_catalog.semantics: Acquire a bounded sensor stream from a user-selected brain-computer interface using an OS-mediated device adapter.
constraints: Requires informed consent, visible activation, data minimization and local-first handling.
No emotion inference or direct thought-to-code guarantee.

operation_catalog.semantics: Map supplied signal features to a declared, user-calibrated intent vocabulary with confidence and abstention.
constraints: Output is a probabilistic hypothesis, not direct access to thoughts or mental state.

components.name: Reality Sandbox
components.mapping: Process/VM isolation or deterministic simulator sandbox; call it Model Sandbox in technical APIs.

components.name: Entropy Monitor
components.mapping: Monitor declared stability metrics, queue pressure, numerical error or model entropy; thresholds are model-specific.

components.name: Causality Lock
components.mapping: Reject non-causal event ordering, invalid time travel requests and inconsistent replay mutations.

components.name: Stop Policy
components.mapping: Bounded timeout, cancellation, cleanup and safe-stop with an auditable event ledger.

frameworks.role: Logical time, snapshots and reproducible simulation.

components.name: Time Bookmark
components.mapping: Versioned checkpoint of a model, simulation or application state.

components.name: Future Preview
components.mapping: Scenario forecast or Monte Carlo projection with assumptions, uncertainty and no guarantee.

components.name: Parallel Thread Manager
components.mapping: Resource-bounded worker pool and deterministic branch scheduler.

components.name: Rollback
components.mapping: Restore an isolated logical snapshot only; external physical events cannot be undone.

frameworks.role: Material modeling and engineering artifact pipeline.

components.name: Atom Library
components.mapping: Versioned element/isotope/species/property database with source and model provenance.

components.name: Structure Blueprint
components.mapping: Validated atomic/molecular geometry, crystal lattice, CAD or device design.

components.name: Energy Model
components.mapping: Dimensioned energy budget and physical process model; E=mc² is not a practical material-synthesis primitive.

components.name: Fabrication Adapter
components.mapping: Explicit, machine-specific plan for a supported printer, deposition, lithography or laboratory process.

components.name: Thought Parser
components.mapping: Signal-processing and user-calibrated intent classifier with confidence and reject/abstain path.

components.name: Emotion Stabilizer
components.mapping: Do not infer or suppress emotions. Replace with signal-quality, fatigue-neutral calibration and operator pause controls.

components.name: Focus Amplifier
components.mapping: Optional user-controlled interaction aid; never claims to amplify cognition or alter the brain.

components.name: Privacy Gate
components.mapping: Local-only by default, explicit consent, short retention, encryption and data deletion controls.

claim_translation.claim: Control the probability that an electron/charge exists.
claim_translation.translation: Model quantum states and measurement probabilities; use a qualified quantum device for physical experiments. Software does not control the quantum vacuum.

claim_translation.claim: Collapse a wavefunction into a desired result.
claim_translation.translation: Perform a declared measurement and return a probabilistic outcome; state preparation and gate operations are distinct from measurement.

claim_translation.claim: Bend spacetime to store more data or slow code.
claim_translation.translation: Run a numerical spacetime/field simulation or optimize memory layout. The simulator cannot bend real spacetime.

claim_translation.claim: Create thousands of alternate realities for algorithm selection.
claim_translation.translation: Run parallel candidate jobs, simulations or parameter sweeps on finite compute resources.

claim_translation.claim: Materialize thoughts or atoms from ambient air.
claim_translation.translation: Generate CAD, molecular/material models and a manufacturing plan; physical production requires feedstock, energy, equipment and process validation.

claim_translation.claim: Travel backward in time or preview a guaranteed future.
claim_translation.translation: Restore a logical checkpoint or run an uncertainty-bearing scenario forecast.

claim_translation.claim: Communicate through entanglement without a signal.
claim_translation.translation: Model entangled correlations and test no-signaling constraints; classical communication still requires a physical channel.

claim_translation.claim: Compile thought directly from a brain.
claim_translation.translation: Acquire consented signals from a named BCI and classify calibrated intent with uncertainty and abstention.

claim_translation.claim: Run below electricity or the laws of physics.
claim_translation.translation: The deepest modeled level is an explicit physical/electrical device model; software remains constrained by the hardware and physical laws it models.

invariants: Simulation output must never be labeled as a live device measurement.
Quantum simulator results must identify the state representation, noise model, measurement basis and random seed.
Field simulations must identify equations, units, discretization, boundary conditions and solver tolerance.
Material simulations must identify species, potential/model, temperature/pressure assumptions and source database.
Fabrication plans must identify feedstock, machine/process profile and required operator approval.
BCI signals are sensitive user data and require explicit consent and local-first handling.
Physical target operations are capability-gated and must have a named device/board revision.

research_domains.meaning: Qubit/state-vector/circuit modeling and named quantum-device integration; no forced measurement outcome.
Neuromorphic neuron/network models and consented neural signal adapters; no unmediated brain access.
Research models for fluidic, phase-change or other emerging memory concepts; no claim of an available liquid-RAM device.
Timestamp and synchronize biosignal streams against declared sampling clocks and uncertainty.
Three-dimensional scene, spatial data and visualization pipeline; holographic output requires a named display device.
Latency-budget analysis and lower-bound measurement; never asserts literal zero latency.
Dimensioned energy/power models and measurements with a named provider; no hidden energy control.
Multi-agent or distributed simulation and search; not a shared human consciousness or telepathy mechanism.
Change simulation resolution, model layer or coordinate representation; no physical dimension travel.

verification_gates.name: Syntax and effect validation
verification_gates.purpose: Check parsing, types, source spans, target declaration, effect set and capability requirements.

verification_gates.name: Model and logic validation
verification_gates.purpose: Check units, conservation constraints, numerical stability, bounds, resource budgets and deterministic/probabilistic provenance.

verification_gates.name: Physical target qualification
verification_gates.purpose: When a physical device is used, validate exact hardware identity/revision, calibration, safety procedure and observed measurements; simulation cannot satisfy this gate.

engineering_practices.resource_control: Every experiment must declare wall-clock, compute, memory, output and recursion/branch limits plus cancellation or watchdog behavior.
engineering_practices.state_backup: Snapshots apply only to logical application/model state and are versioned; no snapshot can back up or restore the physical universe.
engineering_practices.forecast_policy: Future previews are forecasts over assumptions and uncertainty distributions, not guaranteed knowledge of future events.
